facts.statement: Andesaurus was named in 1991 by paleontologists Jorge Orlando Calvo and José Fernando Bonaparte.
facts.quote: In 1991, paleontologists Jorge Orlando Calvo and José Fernando Bonaparte named Andesaurus

facts.statement: The only known species, A. delgadoi, is named after Alejandro Delgado, who discovered the fossils.
facts.quote: Andesaurus fossils were found by Alejandro Delgado, after whom the single known species (A. delgadoi) is named.

facts.statement: The only known material consists of a partial skeleton with four lower back vertebrae and 27 tail vertebrae.
facts.quote: The only known material of Andesaurus is a partial skeleton consisting of a series of four vertebrae from the lower back, as well as 27 tail vertebrae

facts.statement: The Candeleros Formation, where Andesaurus fossils were found, is dated to the early Albian, approximately 111.4 ± 1.1 million years ago.
facts.quote: the maximum depositional age of both the Candeleros Formation and the overlying Huincul Formation is re-dated to the early Albian by Maniel et al. (2026), approximately 111.4 ± 1.1 Ma and 106.2 ± 1.0 Ma respectively.

facts.statement: Andesaurus lived in an environment that was an ancient braided river system.
facts.quote: For the most part, the Candeleros represents an ancient braided river system.

facts.statement: Estimates based on known remains suggest Andesaurus was 15 to 18 meters long and weighed around 7 metric tons.
facts.quote: Total length estimates place the known remains at 15 m to 18 m long, and around 7 MT in body mass.

facts.statement: The dorsal vertebrae of Andesaurus feature an opisthocoelous centrum and large lateral pleurocoels, which are pneumatic depressions.
facts.quote: The dorsal vertebrae of Andesaurus bear the typical features of an opisthocoelous centrum and large lateral pleurocoel (pneumatic depression).

facts.statement: A potentially diagnostic parapophysis ridge is present on one vertebra, though poor preservation prevents its identification on others.
facts.quote: Potentially diagnostic for Andesaurus, there is an additional ridge supporting the lower articulation for the ribs (parapophysis), although poor preservation in other vertebrae means it can only be identified on one bone.

facts.statement: Andesaurus is characterized as the most basal known member of the clade Titanosauria due to several primitive features.
facts.quote: Several plesiomorphic (primitive) features characterize Andesaurus as the most basal known member of Titanosauria.

facts.statement: Currently, Andesaurus is defined by a single feature: tall neural spines on its back vertebrae, requiring further study.
facts.quote: Andesaurus itself is only characterized by a single feature, the tall neural spines on top of its back vertebrae, and needs further study.

facts.statement: Unlike derived titanosaurs with ball-and-socket tail joints, Andesaurus has flat-ended (amphiplatyan) tail vertebrae similar to non-titanosaurian sauropods.
facts.quote: In most derived titanosaurs, the tail vertebrae articulate with ball-and-socket joints, with the hollowed-out socket end on the front (procoelous caudal vertebrae), while in Andesaurus, both ends of the vertebrae are flat (amphiplatyan caudals), as seen in many non-titanosaurian sauropods.

facts.statement: Andesaurus is classified within the family Andesauridae.
facts.quote: familia: Andesauridae

facts.statement: Andesaurus shared its environment with theropods like Buitreraptor and Giganotosaurus, as well as the sauropod Limaysaurus.
facts.quote: Besides Andesaurus, the formation also contains fossils of the theropods Buitreraptor and Giganotosaurus, as well as other sauropods including the rebbachisaurid Limaysaurus.

facts.statement: The fossil remains of Andesaurus were discovered in 1987.
facts.quote: Este hallazgo se produjo en el año 1987.

facts.statement: The discovery expedition was led by the Natural Sciences Museum of the National University of Comahue.
facts.quote: La campaña correspondiente para este descubrimiento fue dirigida por el Museo de Ciencias Naturales de la Universidad Nacional del Comahue.

facts.statement: Andesaurus was a large animal, though not as gigantic as some other members of its group.
facts.quote: El andesaurio fue un animal de gran tamaño, aunque no tenía un tamaño tan gigantesco, como algunos otros miembros pertenecientes a este gran grupo.

facts.statement: Andesaurus is estimated to have reached lengths between 15 and 18 meters and a height of 6 meters.
facts.quote: Se calcula que llegó a medir entre 15 y 18 metros de largo y 6 de alto.

facts.statement: The estimated weight of Andesaurus ranges from 7 to 14 tonnes.
facts.quote: Con un peso entre 7 y 14 toneladas.

facts.statement: Paleontologists Jorge Calvo and José F. Bonaparte named the holotype Andesaurus in 1991, referencing the Andes mountains where it was found.
facts.quote: En 1991, los paleontólogos Jorge Calvo y José F. Bonaparte llamaron a su holotipo Andesaurus, lo que refiere a las montañas de los Andes dada la ubicación del sitio del hallazgo.

facts.statement: The fossils were found by Alejandro Delgado, leading to the species name A. delgadoi.
facts.quote: Los fósiles fueron encontrados por Alejandro Delgado, por lo que la única especie conocida fue llamada A. delgadoi.

facts.statement: The only known material of Andesaurus is a partial skeleton consisting of four posterior dorsal vertebrae and 27 caudal vertebrae divided into two different sets.
facts.quote: El único material conocido de Andesaurus es un esqueleto parcial que consiste en una serie de cuatro vértebras del sector dorsal posterior, y 27 vértebras caudales, divididas en dos conjuntos de partes diferentes de la cola.

facts.statement: Additional pelvic elements were discovered, including two ischia, the pubis, rib fragments, and incomplete humerus and femur.
facts.quote: Varios elementos de la pelvis también fueron descubiertos, incluyendo dos ischia y el hueso del pubis, junto con fragmentos de costillas y un húmero y fémur incompletos.

facts.statement: Andesaurus is characterized by a single distinguishing feature: high neural spines on its dorsal vertebrae.
facts.quote: Andesaurus está caracterizado solamente por un solo diferencial: las espinas neurales altas encima de sus vértebras dorsales, por lo que se hace necesario estudiarlo en mayor profundidad.

facts.statement: Several plesiomorphic characteristics identify Andesaurus as the most basal known member of Titanosauria.
facts.quote: Varias características plesiomórficas muestran a Andesaurus como el miembro conocido más basal de Titanosauria.

facts.statement: The clade Titanosauria is defined to contain Andesaurus, Saltasaurus, their most recent common ancestor, and all their descendants.
facts.quote: De hecho este clado se ha definido "para contener a Andesaurus, Saltasaurus, su antepasado común más reciente, y todos sus descendientes".

facts.statement: Andesaurus lived in South America during the mid-Cretaceous period, approximately between 99.6 and 97 million years ago in the Cenomanian stage.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente,entre 99,6 y 97 millones de años, en el Cenomaniense, en Sudamérica.

facts.statement: Fossils were discovered in the lower section of the Candeleros Formation, the oldest within the Neuquén Group in Neuquén Province, Argentina.
facts.quote: Estos fósiles fueron descubiertos en la sección inferior de la Formación Candeleros, la más antigua dentro de Grupo Neuquén de la provincia del Neuquén, Argentina.

facts.statement: The fossils were found about 5 kilometers from the locality of El Chocón.
facts.quote: A unos 5km de la localidad de El Chocón.

facts.statement: The Candeleros Formation is dated to the Lower Cretaceous Cenomanian, approximately 100 to 97 million years ago.
facts.quote: Esta formación está fechada en el Cenomaniense del Cretáceo inferior, o aproximadamente cerca de los 100 a 97 millones de años.

facts.statement: The Candeleros Formation largely represents an ancient braided river system.
facts.quote: Por la mayor parte, Candeleros representa un antiguo sistema fluvial trenzado

facts.statement: Andesaurus belongs to the parent group Titanosauria.
facts.quote: Parent group: Titanosauria

facts.statement: Andesaurus is classified in the class Saurischia.
facts.quote: Class: Saurischia

facts.statement: The Paleobiology Database lists the time range for Andesaurus as the Albian, from 113.2 to 110.1 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Albian to Albian (113.2 to 110.1 million years ago)
